Senior Software Engineer - Storage Platform
 Job removed Location Midtjylland, Denmark Team Engineer Subteam Software Engineering Posted on Oct 15, 2026 Meet the Eng team
 Driving innovation at scale
 About the Role 
 Engineering at Uber means building for real-world impact under real-world constraints. You’ll be responsible for the infrastructure that runs Uber’s global stateful systems - over 20 types of technologies including MySQL, Redis, and Kafka - across 50,000+ hosts and exabytes of data.
 This role is based in our Aarhus, Denmark office, a key global hub for Uber’s Infrastructure and Platform teams. In Aarhus, we don’t just use technology; we build the core systems that keep Uber moving. The work is massive in scale and high in stakes. You will navigate the tension between moving fast to increase fleet-wide efficiency and maintaining the extreme reliability required for systems that never sleep.
 We are looking for an engineer eager to grow into a role with greater technical ownership and leadership. As our Stateful Platform team continues to scale, we need someone who can go beyond execution to formulate a north star vision for our products. You will be expected to drive the team toward that goal independently, staying steady through the regular disruptions that come with operating at our scale. If you thrive in high-ambiguity environments, value ownership over hierarchy, you will grow here.
 What You’ll Do 
 Design, build, and maintain the automation frameworks that deploy and run all database engines globally, ensuring high availability across on-prem and multiple cloud environments.
 Solve high-impact infrastructure problems where the solution isn't always obvious - such as automating kernel upgrades or storage cluster expansions across millions of containers.
 Build and own services written in Go, focusing on system reliability, resource forecasting, and intelligent placement to maximize utilization.
 Navigate the messiness of technical debt and shifting priorities, ensuring every code change is backed by rigorous testing while maintaining a bias for action.
 Unblock fleet-wide efficiency by optimizing scheduling, with the goal of eliminating manual on-call operations through automation.
 Lead through influence by mentoring peers and collaborating across global engineering sites (SF, Amsterdam, Seattle, Bangalore) to ship practical solutions at speed.
 Engage with the local community by participating in or leading tech meetups hosted at our Aarhus office to share knowledge and drive engineering excellence locally.
 Discover what we're building at Uber Aarhus on our blog: https://www.uber.com/dk/en/blog/engineering/aarhus/ 
 Basic Qualifications 
 5+ years of professional software development experience.
 Proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g., Go, Java, Python).
 Experience with software engineering fundamentals, including testing methodologies and quality documentation.
 Technical depth in building or managing distributed systems at scale.
 Demonstrated ability to lead technical direction and help a team navigate through ambiguity and complex organizational changes.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
 Knowledge of database and stateful systems (e.g., MySQL, Kafka, HDFS, or Redis).
 A mindset for automation —specifically a track record of replacing manual processes with self-healing systems.
 Perks & Benefits: 
 Monthly Uber Credits: Credits to use on Uber Rides and Uber Eats every month.
 Equity Compensation: Opportunity to be awarded stock options (RSUs) to ensure you own a piece of the mission you’re building.
 Culture & Socials: Frequent local social events and office clubs (chess, board games, running, crossfit, creative club and more)
 Tech Community: We host regular local tech meetups to stay connected with the Aarhus engineering scene, and give our engineers the opportunity to sometimes share what they’re working on with the community
 Well-being & Fertility: Global support programs for mental health, wellness, and family planning/fertility.
 Parental Leave: Generous, gender-neutral parental leave to support your life outside of work.
 Modern Aarhus Hub: Work in a center of technical excellence featuring catered lunches and top-tier collaboration spaces.
 Ready to ride? Uber’s mission is to reimagine the way the world moves for the better. Here, bold ideas create real-world impact, challenges drive growth, and speed fuels progress. This isn’t the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it’s where you help write one. If you’re driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves, this is the place for you. What moves us, moves the world - let’s move it forward, together. 
 Working Style & Accommodations: Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber’s culture. Our Aarhus office is a hub where deep engineering happens in a highly collaborative environment. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday in-office. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role’s requirements.

Software Engineer - Denmark Pool
 Job removed Location Midtjylland, Denmark Team Engineer Subteam Software Engineering Posted on Oct 7, 2026 Meet the Eng team
 Driving innovation at scale
 ~~ ~~ ~~
 Building the Backbone of Global Motion: Backend Engineers (Denmark Pool) 
 Location : Aarhus, Denmark
 This posting is specifically for local candidates based in or able to attend in-person networking in Denmark. If you are currently residing abroad and are looking for international opportunities, please check out our other open positions on our website.  
 At Uber, we don’t just move people; we move the world. But before a car arrives or a meal is delivered, millions of lines of code have to execute in milliseconds. Our Aarhus Engineering Hub is the engine room for some of Uber’s most critical global systems. We are looking to connect with Backend Software Engineers who want to build the future of Infrastructure/Platform and Catalog at a scale few companies on earth ever reach.
 Why Join Our Talent Pool? 
 By joining our Aarhus Talent Pool, you’re putting yourself on the radar for our two most impactful engineering pillars in Denmark:
 Platform & Infrastructure You’ll build the "foundations of the house." This team ensures that Uber’s global fleet of services is reliable, scalable, and lightning-fast. If you enjoy deep-diving into distributed systems, high-availability architecture, and cloud-native tech, this is your playground.
 Catalog Platform Uber’s Catalog is the world’s most complex digital inventory. We manage millions of items across thousands of cities for Uber Eats and beyond. You’ll solve "impossible" problems related to data consistency, searchability, and real-time updates at a massive scale.
 What We’re Looking For 
 We value engineering craft over specific buzzwords, but you’ll feel right at home if you have:
 Drive & Passion for Engineering: This is the most important aspect. You have a deep passion for engineering excellence and a strong internal drive to do outstanding work. You naturally seek out challenging problems, learn quickly, and care deeply about craft and execution—consistently pushing for better solutions, systems, and outcomes while thriving in an environment with high autonomy.
 Distributed Systems Experience: You understand how to build systems that don’t break when millions of people use them simultaneously.
 Language Agnosticism: Our primary languages are Go and Java, but we care more about your ability to pick the right tool for the job.
 A "Scale" Mindset: You don't just write code; you think about observability, latency, and how your service behaves at 100x its current load.
 Collaborative Spirit: You thrive in a culture of peer reviews, architectural discussions, and shared ownership.
 This pipeline is intended for candidates with approximately 2+ years of relevant industry experience after completing their education. Alternatively a PhD degree. The role level corresponds to an L4 position - Software Engineer 2. Learn more about the L4 Uber hiring process and how to prepare here: https://jobs.uber.com/en/uber-interview-guide/backend-engineering-interview-guide/ 
 The Aarhus Edge 
 Uber Aarhus isn't just a satellite office; it’s an engineering powerhouse with a "start-up" soul and "Big Tech" impact.
 Global Impact: Your code affects how people move in 10,000+ cities.
 Local Culture: A tight-knit team in the heart of Jutland, where we value work-life balance and technical excellence.
 Growth: We invest heavily in our engineers. Whether you want to be a Staff Engineer or an Engineering Manager, the path is yours to build.
 Let’s Start a Conversation 
 Even if you aren’t looking to move today, we want to know the bright minds in the Danish tech community.
 If you are not selected to move forward in the process after submitting your application, you may still be a great fit for future opportunities with Uber. We will keep your CV in our system and may contact you regarding relevant roles or invitations to technical events in the future.
 If new roles are posted for Uber Aarhus that match your interests, we encourage you to apply again so we know you are interested in that specific position. If you are curious about the work we do at Uber Aarhus, please read more on our blog or sign up for our talent community.
 Uber Engineering blog: https://www.uber.com/dk/en/blog/engineering/ 
 Uber Talent Community: https://flows.beamery.com/uber/join-our-talent-community 
 Perks & Benefits 
 Monthly Uber Credits: Credits to use on Uber Rides and Uber Eats every month.
 Equity Compensation: Opportunity to be awarded stock options (RSUs) to ensure you own a piece of the mission you’re building.
 Culture & Socials: Frequent local social events and office clubs (chess, board games, running, CrossFit, creative clubs, and more).
 Tech Community: We host regular local tech meetups to stay connected with the Aarhus engineering scene, and give our engineers the opportunity to sometimes share what they’re working on with the community.
 Well-being & Fertility: Global support programs for mental health, wellness, and family planning/fertility.
 Parental Leave: Generous, gender-neutral parental leave to support your life outside of work.
 Modern Aarhus Hub: Work in a center of technical excellence featuring catered lunches and top-tier collaboration spaces.
 Learn more about Uber’s benefits here: https://jobs.uber.com/en/benefits/ 
 If you are a student or recent graduate, we encourage you to join our Early Talent Network, where you can meet Uber employees and network. https://pages.beamery.com/uber/page/etndk 
 Relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not provided for this position. If you are currently residing elsewhere but planning to relocate to Aarhus, please state this clearly in your resume. 
 If you haven't heard from us within three weeks of submitting your application, it means we won't be moving forward with your candidacy at this time. However, we will keep your resume on file for future opportunities, upcoming tech events, and future talent outreach. You may remove your candidacy at any time via your candidate profile. 
 Uber is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Sr Software Engineer - Deployment Platform
 Job removed Location Midtjylland, Denmark Team Engineer Subteam Software Engineering Posted on Aug 7, 2026 Meet the Eng team
 Driving innovation at scale
 About the role and team  
 Uber's Deployment Engine team is the backbone of how the world's largest ride-sharing and delivery platform safely ships innovation at scale impacting ~ 150 million  customers. Our deployment platform enforces policies and gathers real-time signals to ensure that every change to Uber's production systems rolls out incrementally and automatically reverts if those signals hint at trouble.
 Our mission is simple: make production deployments stress-free for every engineer at Uber. We do this by building intelligent guardrails that continuously evolve alongside new workload types, deployment patterns, and scale demands. With  ~1M rollout operations per week across our deployment systems , orchestrating changes safely is a genuinely hard problem and one we're deeply passionate about solving. The stakes are real: our systems directly impact  150 million+ monthly active platform consumers globally,  7 million+ active drivers and couriers and services in  70+ countries and  10,000+ cities. 
 Our platform makes high-precision, data-driven decisions to detect potential incidents and regressions early and automatically, dramatically reducing the risk of outages. We power capabilities like:
 Automatic rollbacks of bad deployments
 Emergency deploy policies and system lockdowns during active incidents
 Incident mitigation tooling that keeps Uber's services available and reliable
 If you're energized by wrestling with distributed systems edge cases, using cutting edge technologies and infrastructure challenges, the kind that keep a global business running, you'll thrive here. You'll work on a critical platform that enables Uber to innovate rapidly without compromising safety or reliability, making our customers happy and our services world-class.
 What you’ll do  
 Be responsible for the delivery of multiple projects from inception to production readiness in the team. 
 Own key KPIs, metrics, OKRs and goals of the team.
 Address stakeholder requirements and/or improve end-user experience by designing elegant backend platform components for high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems.
 Tackle challenging problems with innovative design and algorithms.
 Collaborate and mentor team members to maintain system health, ensure code hygiene, refactor, and enhance system robustness and resilience.
 Promote and evangelize best practices in code health, testing, and maintainability within the team.
 Analyze and decompose complex software systems, working with cross-functional teams to design for scalability and testability.
 Basic Qualifications  
 Coding Skills : Proficient in writing clean, well tested and elegant code.
 Architecture : Understanding of distributed systems architecture, including consensus, convergence, data consistency, and performance/efficiency constructs. Ability to identify and resolve performance and scalability issues.
 Experience : 5+ years as a software engineer focused on building large-scale distributed systems with proven impact.
 Communication : Effective communication and collaboration skills, be a strong team player.
 Engineering Best Practices : Commitment to setting and driving the team towards the bar on engineering best practices. Owns the team’s engineering culture in terms of quality, monitoring, and on-call practices.
 Preferred Qualifications  
 Engineering Excellence : Defines and drives improvements to product and engineering quality (e.g. sustainability, maintainability, performance, reliability, etc.) within their team and projects. 
 Leadership : Proven experience leading engineering teams to deliver large, multi-functional projects autonomously. Ability to own part of the team’s charter and help set the long-term direction.
 Perks & Benefits:

 Equity Compensation: Opportunity to be awarded stock options (RSUs) to ensure you own a piece of the mission you’re building.
 Culture & Socials: Frequent local social events and office clubs (chess, board games, running, crossfit, creative club, and more).
 Tech Community: We host regular local tech meetups to stay connected with the Aarhus engineering scene, and give our engineers the opportunity to sometimes share what they’re working on with the community.

Software Engineer II - Engineer
 Job removed Location Toronto, Canada Team Engineer Subteam Software Engineering Posted on Oct 15, 2026 Meet the Eng team
 Driving innovation at scale
 About the Role
 The Maps Search team builds features and experiences that expand how people use Search at Uber. Our work connects search, maps, and personalized discovery to help users explore places and find relevant offerings across Uber’s businesses, including Rides, Eats, and Ads.
 As a Backend Software Engineer on the team, you’ll build the services and APIs behind these experiences. You’ll work alongside backend, mobile, and machine learning engineers, as well as product managers and data scientists, to turn ideas into reliable, performant features. Projects include cross line of business functionality in search, exploration and local discovery, with opportunities to build new experiences from the ground up.
 This is a hands-on, product-focused engineering role. You’ll own well-scoped features from technical design through implementation, experimentation, deployment, and production monitoring, with support from experienced engineers. You’ll tackle distributed systems challenges while seeing how your work improves the customer experience and contributes to Uber’s Growth.
 What You Will Do
 Build customer-facing features: Develop backend services and APIs that power search, map exploration, and local discovery experiences.
 Own delivery end to end: Take well-scoped features from design through implementation, testing, rollout, and monitoring, collaborating with senior engineers on broader architectural decisions.
 Engineer for scale and reliability: Improve service performance, scalability, and resilience, balancing customer needs with maintainable technical solutions.
 Collaborate across disciplines: Partner with mobile engineers, machine learning engineers, product managers, and data scientists to deliver cohesive experiences.
 Experiment and learn: Support A/B tests, instrument features, and use results to understand customer impact and guide improvements.
 Maintain engineering quality: Write clean, well-tested code, participate in design and code reviews, and contribute to shared engineering practices.
 Support production systems: Investigate issues, strengthen observability, and contribute to the operational health of the services you build.
 Basic Qualifications
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, including building and shipping backend services.
 Proficiency in a backend programming language such as Go, Java, or a comparable language.
 Strong foundations in data structures, algorithms, API design, and software testing.
 Experience working with databases and distributed systems, with an understanding of performance and reliability trade-offs.
 Ability to deliver well-scoped projects independently, communicate technical decisions clearly, and collaborate effectively with teammates and cross-functional partners.
 Preferred Qualifications
 Experience with search systems, including retrieval, ranking, or search indices.
 Familiarity with personalization, recommendation systems, or integrating machine learning capabilities into backend services.
 Experience working with geospatial data, maps, points of interest, or location-based products.
 Familiarity with A/B testing, product analytics, and metrics-driven feature development.
 Experience operating production services, including monitoring, debugging, and safe deployment practices.
 Experience building consumer-facing products in collaboration with mobile engineering teams.
 For Canada-based roles: The base salary range for this role is CAD $144,000 per year - CAD $160,000 per year.
